title: Ensemble Complexity in Photovoltaic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.15049v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An ensemble can improve photovoltaic forecasts while adding components that contribute little or increase computation. We assess these effects through matched comparisons and ablations of a fixed heterogeneous predictor bank. Hourly experiments use GEFCom2014 and three additional public datasets, with chronological partitions and three seeds. Under retrospective ERA5 assistance, static fusion reduces scaled mean absolute error against matched boosting by 1.11%, 4.41%, and 1.63% on PVDAQ, OPSD, and Ausgrid; only OPSD remains supported after multiple-comparison correction. Weather gating offers no consistent incremental benefit. Exploratory member removals show group-level dependence alongside individual redundancy. A separate, previously inspected fifteen-minute case replaces one neural member with a tree predictor: normalized error falls by 1.72%, but measured inference is slower. translated_title: 光伏预测中的集成复杂度
translated_abstract: 集成方法能够改善光伏预测，但同时也会引入贡献甚微或增加计算量的组件。我们通过对固定异构预测器库进行匹配比较和消融实验来评估这些影响。小时级实验使用GEFCom2014以及另外三个公开数据集，采用按时间顺序划分的数据和三个随机种子。在回顾性ERA5气象数据辅助下，静态融合在PVDAQ、OPSD和Ausgrid数据集上相比匹配的boosting方法分别将归一化平均绝对误差降低了1.11%、4.41%和1.63%；经多重比较校正后，仅OPSD上的结果仍具统计支持。天气门控未带来一致的增量收益。探索性的成员移除实验表明，组级依赖性与个体冗余并存。在另一个单独考察的15分钟分辨率案例中，用一个树模型预测器替换一个神经网络成员后，归一化误差下降了1.72%，但实测推理速度变慢。这些发现支持对集成组件进行逐一评估……
tldr: 该研究通过匹配比较与消融实验量化光伏预测集成的复杂度代价，发现静态融合仅在部分数据集上显著降低误差、天气门控无一致增益、以树模型替换神经成员虽降低误差但拖慢推理，从而支持对集成组件进行逐一评估。
en_tdlr: Through matched comparisons and ablations, this paper quantifies the complexity cost of photovoltaic forecast ensembles, showing that static fusion yields significant error reductions on only some datasets, weather gating offers no consistent benefit, and replacing a neural member with a tree predictor lowers error but slows inference, supporting component-wise ensemble evaluation.
